title: What Scripture Actually Means by Take Every Thought Captive
caption:
What Scripture means by taking every thought captive.

It's not a nice idea. It's a daily arrest.

A thought walking through your head isn't guilt. It's a visitor. What you do in the next ten seconds decides if it becomes a guest, or a name you have to confess later.

Paul doesn't say negotiate with it. He says take it captive. You don't debate a thief in your house. You stop him at the door, and you replace him with what's true. "That's a lie" isn't enough on its own.

Catch it early, and it costs you ten seconds. Catch it late, and it costs you a season.

theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
